approval.notes: Bounded local synthetic prototype and v0.4 preservation bookkeeping only. L0/F0 live access remains separately gated; no collection, publication, commit, or push is authorized by this record.

first_evaluated_edition.contract: C01-C04, three configurations, three repetitions per scenario/configuration
first_evaluated_edition.native_session_note: Each C04 scenario run creates two native sessions. Do not convert scheduled scenario runs into a single native-session total.

recovery_edition.contract: C05 three configurations x three repetitions; C06 three configurations x three conditions x three repetitions
recovery_edition.native_session_note: Native-session multiplicity is recorded per run/capture after collection; no total is inferred for recovery runs.

calibration.contract: Three configurations x C01/C02 once, plus one separately budgeted advanced-profile attempt
calibration.native_session_note: The advanced profile and recovery stages do not receive an invented native-session total.

feasibility_gate.contract: One CLI, one valid C01 and one valid C02; copied offline decoding and damaged-fixture detection are derived evaluations
feasibility_gate.native_session_note: Derived copied/damaged evaluations add no native session.
